name: GDCToken sell burn exceeds forwarded amount, with reentrant tax-free exit
summary: GDCToken's sell hook forwards 30% of a taxed sell to the pair but burns the full sold amount from the pair's reserve and syncs, and a mid-sell referral BNB callback lets transfers into the pair skip the tax. Constructor-deposit helpers bought GDC; a sell then collapsed the GDC reserve while a pre-bought bag was dumped tax-free at the inflated price.
notes: Direct immutable GDCToken; later owner changes (deposit bounds, node levels) and the inviter migration batches are not needed by the exploit.

Campaign: four unaffiliated copycat sells through the same pair burn within 2,400 blocks of the anchor (bots 0x5a4709ad, 0x718a46af, 0x00000000007ea156, 0x41a1d3ec); no earlier sell took more than 0.3 BNB from the pair.

Loss is the pair's gross WBNB depletion over the anchor and copycats (rule 11), so it includes the tax swap-back the token routed to company, referral and LP paths; the GDC burned from the pair is not valued separately.
